defect.description: The setting is read as settings['FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE'] or False instead of settings.getbool(...): command-line overrides arrive as text, so -s FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE=False (or =0) gives the non-empty string 'False', which is truthy and turns active mode on.

review_items: feedstorage.py:27 string 'false' from CLI is truthy with `or False`, enabling active mode; use getbool
tests don't exercise from_command_line string values
tests don't verify store() calls set_pasv(False)
`or False` is dead code since DEFAULTS provides False; use getbool
pre-existing FTP connection leak when cwd/storbinary raises
votes.evidence_quote: When the user passes `-s FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE=false`, the value is the string `"false"`, which is truthy, so `or False` is never reached and `self.active` becomes truthy — enabling active mode when the user explicitly disabled it. Use `settings.getbool("FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE")` instead
votes.justification: The review places the bug at the right line in from_settings. It gives the right cause: a command-line string is truthy under `or False`. It gives the right symptom (active mode turns on) and the right fix (getbool).
